import { gsap } from 'gsap';
import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger';
gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

export function attachScrollAnimations() {
    const animations = [];

    // Track 0: .card-1
    animations.push(gsap.fromTo(".card-1",
        { opacity: 0, y: 20, scale: 0.9 },
        {
            opacity: 1,
            y: 0,
            scale: 1,
            ease: "power1.out",
            scrollTrigger: {
                trigger: ".card-1",
                start: "0% top",
                end: "33% top",
                scrub: true
            }
        }));

    // Track 1: .card-2
    animations.push(gsap.fromTo(".card-2",
        { opacity: 0, rotation: -8 },
        {
            opacity: 1,
            rotation: 0,
            ease: "sine.inOut",
            scrollTrigger: {
                trigger: ".card-2",
                start: "33% top",
                end: "66% top",
                scrub: true
            }
        }));

    return function detach() {
        for (let i = 0; i < animations.length; i++) {
            const anim = animations[i];
            if (anim && anim.scrollTrigger) anim.scrollTrigger.kill();
        }
    };
}
